rules.text_en: Ride at a speed you can stop from within the distance you can see to be clear
rules.text_hi: उतनी ही रफ़्तार रखें जिस पर आप साफ़ दिख रही दूरी के भीतर रुक सकें।
rules.source_note: Team practice statement from the curriculum. Status 'review pending': two-person review (CURRICULUM §5) flips it to verified; until then it is not AI-citable.

rules.text_en: Obey posted speed limits
rules.text_hi: लगाई गई गति-सीमा का पालन करें।
rules.source_title: Motor Vehicles Act 1988 as amended (speed-limit provisions; section to pin)
rules.source_note: Section number not pinned. India Code is the cited host for the Act (CURRICULUM §2.0); the section must be fetched and checked by a second person before verified flips.

rules.text_en: Pedestrian death risk is under 20% below 50 km/h and about 60% at 80 km/h
rules.text_hi: 50 किमी/घंटा से कम रफ़्तार पर पैदल यात्री की मृत्यु का जोखिम 20% से कम और 80 किमी/घंटा पर लगभग 60% होता है।
rules.source_title: WHO road traffic injuries fact sheet (not re-fetched)
rules.source_note: Not re-fetched since research (CURRICULUM M2 open item). Only the two published reference points may be used; no invented curve. Evidence text for cited 'why this matters' cards only.

rules.text_en: Rider and pillion must wear a protective helmet
rules.text_hi: चलाने वाले और पीछे बैठी सवारी, दोनों को सुरक्षात्मक हेलमेट पहनना ज़रूरी है।
rules.source_note: s.129 text and its exemptions not re-fetched (CURRICULUM M3 legal review).

rules.text_en: Look for the ISI mark (IS 4151) on helmets
rules.text_hi: हेलमेट पर ISI मार्क (IS 4151) देखें।
rules.source_title: Bureau of Indian Standards, IS 4151 protective helmets (reference to pin)
rules.source_note: BIS standard reference and URL not pinned (CURRICULUM M3).

rules.text_en: Fasten the strap; two fingers fit under it; the helmet shouldn't rock
rules.text_hi: स्ट्रैप बाँधें; उसके नीचे दो उँगलियाँ आएँ; हेलमेट हिलना नहीं चाहिए।
rules.source_note: Team practice statement from the curriculum. Status 'review pending': two-person review (CURRICULUM §5) flips it to verified; until then it is not AI-citable.

rules.text_en: Stay out of a truck's or bus's no-zones; if you can't see the driver in the mirror, he can't see you
rules.text_hi: ट्रक या बस के नो-ज़ोन से दूर रहें; अगर आपको शीशे में ड्राइवर नहीं दिखता, तो वह भी आपको नहीं देख सकता।
rules.source_note: Team practice statement from the curriculum. Status 'review pending': two-person review (CURRICULUM §5) flips it to verified; until then it is not AI-citable.

rules.text_en: Overtake only on the right
rules.text_hi: ओवरटेक सिर्फ़ दाईं ओर से करें।
rules.source_title: Motor Vehicles (Driving) Regulations 2017 (regulation no. to pin)
rules.source_note: Gazette text of the MV (Driving) Regulations 2017 not fetched (CURRICULUM §2.0 open item). When pinning, check the regulation's wording and any exception (for example a vehicle ahead that has signalled and moved over to turn right) before this text is approved.

rules.text_en: When a large vehicle indicates or turns left, hold back behind it
rules.text_hi: जब कोई बड़ा वाहन बायाँ इंडिकेटर दे या बाएँ मुड़े, तो उसके पीछे रुके रहें।
rules.source_note: Team practice statement from the curriculum. Status 'review pending': two-person review (CURRICULUM §5) flips it to verified; until then it is not AI-citable.

rules.text_en: At junctions: slow, look right, left and right again, creep to see, then go
rules.text_hi: चौराहे पर: धीमे हों, दाएँ, बाएँ और फिर से दाएँ देखें, धीरे-धीरे आगे बढ़कर देखें, फिर जाएँ।
rules.source_note: Team practice statement from the curriculum. Status 'review pending': two-person review (CURRICULUM §5) flips it to verified; until then it is not AI-citable.

rules.text_en: Give way to pedestrians on a crossing and to traffic already in the junction
rules.text_hi: क्रॉसिंग पर पैदल यात्रियों को और चौराहे में पहले से मौजूद वाहनों को रास्ता दें।
rules.source_note: MVDR 2017 gazette text not fetched; regulation numbers to pin.

rules.text_en: Keep at least a 3-second gap; 4 or more in wet or at night
rules.text_hi: आगे वाले वाहन से कम से कम 3 सेकंड का फ़ासला रखें; गीली सड़क पर या रात में 4 सेकंड या उससे ज़्यादा।
rules.source_note: Team practice statement from the curriculum. Status 'review pending': two-person review (CURRICULUM §5) flips it to verified; until then it is not AI-citable.

rules.text_en: Dip headlights for oncoming traffic and when following
rules.text_hi: सामने से आते वाहनों के लिए और किसी के पीछे चलते समय हेडलाइट डिप (लो बीम) करें।
rules.source_note: MVDR 2017 gazette text not fetched; regulation number to pin.

rules.text_en: When dazzled, look to the left edge and slow down
rules.text_hi: चकाचौंध होने पर सड़क के बाएँ किनारे की ओर देखें और धीमे हो जाएँ।
rules.source_note: Team practice statement from the curriculum. Status 'review pending': two-person review (CURRICULUM §5) flips it to verified; until then it is not AI-citable.

rules.text_en: Ride within the distance your lights show
rules.text_hi: ऐसी रफ़्तार रखें कि हेडलाइट जितनी दूरी दिखाती है, उसके भीतर रुक सकें।
rules.source_note: Team practice statement from the curriculum. Status 'review pending': two-person review (CURRICULUM §5) flips it to verified; until then it is not AI-citable.

rules.text_en: Keep left; never ride against traffic
rules.text_hi: बाईं ओर चलें; कभी भी उल्टी दिशा में न चलें।
rules.source_note: MVDR 2017 gazette text not fetched; regulation number to pin.

rules.text_en: No handheld phone use while riding or driving
rules.text_hi: बाइक या गाड़ी चलाते समय हाथ में फ़ोन लेकर इस्तेमाल न करें।
rules.source_title: Motor Vehicles Act 1988 s.184 (as cited in verification row 11; not re-fetched)
rules.source_note: s.184 not re-fetched; the wording must be checked against the Act before verified flips.

rules.text_en: Riding with blood alcohol above the legal limit is an offence
rules.text_hi: क़ानूनी सीमा से ज़्यादा शराब पीकर गाड़ी चलाना अपराध है।
rules.source_title: Motor Vehicles Act 1988 s.185 (limit not re-fetched)
rules.source_note: The legal limit is not re-fetched, so no number appears anywhere in content; it renders from this catalogue only after verification (CURRICULUM M11).

rules.text_en: Seatbelts for driver and passengers
rules.text_hi: ड्राइवर और सभी सवारियों के लिए सीट बेल्ट।
rules.source_title: Central Motor Vehicles Rules 1989 (rule to pin)
rules.source_note: CMVR rule number not pinned (CURRICULUM M12).

rules.text_en: Child pillion: helmet, harness and a speed cap
rules.text_hi: बच्चे को पीछे बिठाने पर: हेलमेट, हार्नेस और रफ़्तार की सीमा।
rules.source_title: Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 2022 amendment (not re-fetched)
rules.source_note: Amendment text not re-fetched; the age band and speed cap render only after verification (CURRICULUM M13).

rules.text_en: On steep roads, downhill traffic gives way to uphill traffic
rules.text_hi: खड़ी ढलान वाली सड़कों पर नीचे उतरते वाहन, ऊपर चढ़ते वाहनों को रास्ता देते हैं।
rules.source_note: Uphill priority not re-fetched; the AI may not cite it until verified (GAME_DESIGN §13). HR_NO_YIELD_UPHILL falls back to RR-HIL-003.

rules.text_en: Go downhill in a low gear; don't coast; don't ride the brakes
rules.text_hi: ढलान पर नीचे के गियर में उतरें; न्यूट्रल में न लुढ़कें; लगातार ब्रेक दबाकर न चलें।
rules.source_note: Team practice statement from the curriculum. Status 'review pending': two-person review (CURRICULUM §5) flips it to verified; until then it is not AI-citable.

rules.text_en: Use the horn at blind bends; never overtake on a bend; wait at a widening for oncoming heavy vehicles
rules.text_hi: अंधे मोड़ पर हॉर्न दें; मोड़ पर कभी ओवरटेक न करें; सामने से भारी वाहन आए तो चौड़ी जगह पर रुककर इंतज़ार करें।
rules.source_note: Team practice statement from the curriculum. Status 'review pending': two-person review (CURRICULUM §5) flips it to verified; until then it is not AI-citable.

rules.text_en: Don't stop under loose slopes; check the J&K Traffic Police road status before a hill trip
rules.text_hi: ढीली ढलानों के नीचे न रुकें; पहाड़ी सफ़र से पहले J&K ट्रैफ़िक पुलिस से सड़क की स्थिति देख लें।
rules.source_note: Team practice statement from the curriculum. Status 'review pending': two-person review (CURRICULUM §5) flips it to verified; until then it is not AI-citable.

rules.text_en: In fog or rain: slow down, longer gap, low beam, never high beam in fog
rules.text_hi: कोहरे या बारिश में: धीमे चलें, ज़्यादा फ़ासला रखें, लो बीम रखें, कोहरे में कभी हाई बीम नहीं।
rules.source_note: Team practice statement from the curriculum. Status 'review pending': two-person review (CURRICULUM §5) flips it to verified; until then it is not AI-citable.

rules.text_en: Scan well ahead; brake before a pothole, not in it
rules.text_hi: दूर तक आगे देखें; गड्ढे से पहले ब्रेक लगाएँ, गड्ढे के अंदर नहीं।
rules.source_note: Team practice statement from the curriculum. Status 'review pending': two-person review (CURRICULUM §5) flips it to verified; until then it is not AI-citable.

rules.text_en: Expect people stepping out at bus stops, markets and school gates; slow down there
rules.text_hi: बस स्टॉप, बाज़ार और स्कूल के गेट पर लोगों के अचानक सड़क पर आने की उम्मीद रखें; वहाँ धीमे चलें।
rules.source_note: Team practice statement from the curriculum. Status 'review pending': two-person review (CURRICULUM §5) flips it to verified; until then it is not AI-citable.

rules.text_en: A person who helps a crash victim in good faith is protected
rules.text_hi: जो व्यक्ति नेक नीयत से सड़क हादसे में घायल व्यक्ति की मदद करता है, उसे क़ानूनी सुरक्षा मिलती है।
rules.source_note: s.134A (Good Samaritan, 2019 amendment) not re-fetched; legal review of the wording pending (CURRICULUM M19).

rules.text_en: Call 112 (or 108 for an ambulance) right after making the scene safe
rules.text_hi: जगह को सुरक्षित करने के तुरंत बाद 112 (या एम्बुलेंस के लिए 108) पर कॉल करें।
rules.source_note: Team practice statement from the curriculum. Status 'review pending': two-person review (CURRICULUM §5) flips it to verified; until then it is not AI-citable.

rules.text_en: First-aid order: scene safe → call → don't remove a helmet if a neck injury is possible → control bleeding → keep warm, talk → hand over
rules.text_hi: प्राथमिक उपचार का क्रम: जगह सुरक्षित करें → कॉल करें → गर्दन में चोट की आशंका हो तो हेलमेट न उतारें → बहता ख़ून रोकें → गर्म रखें, बात करते रहें → मदद आने पर सौंपें।
rules.source_note: Draft. Needs a qualified medical reviewer (MBBS doctor or certified EMS trainer) recorded in reviewed_by with a date. Medical entries never enter an AI allowlist; templates may show it only after sign-off, with 'Draft, not medical advice' until then.

rules.text_en: Definition of the "golden hour"
rules.text_hi: "गोल्डन आवर" (पहला घंटा) की परिभाषा
rules.source_note: s.2(12A) not re-fetched; the definition text renders only after verification.

rules.text_en: Guardian/owner liability for offences by a juvenile
rules.text_hi: नाबालिग के अपराध के लिए अभिभावक या वाहन मालिक की ज़िम्मेदारी
rules.source_note: s.199A not re-fetched; penalty details render only after verification (CURRICULUM M20).

rules.text_en: 60-second pre-ride check: tyres, controls, lights, oil, chassis, stand
rules.text_hi: चलने से पहले 60 सेकंड की जाँच: टायर, कंट्रोल, लाइटें, ऑयल, चेसिस, स्टैंड।
rules.source_note: Team practice statement from the curriculum. Status 'review pending': two-person review (CURRICULUM §5) flips it to verified; until then it is not AI-citable.

rules.text_en: Break every 2 hours on long rides
rules.text_hi: लंबे सफ़र में हर 2 घंटे पर रुककर आराम करें।
rules.source_note: Team practice statement from the curriculum. Status 'review pending': two-person review (CURRICULUM §5) flips it to verified; until then it is not AI-citable.

rules.text_en: On a learner's licence: "L" plates front and rear and a licensed driver beside you
rules.text_hi: लर्नर लाइसेंस पर: आगे और पीछे "L" प्लेट, और साथ में लाइसेंस वाला ड्राइवर।
rules.source_title: Central Motor Vehicles Rules 1989 r.3 (secondary sources only)
rules.source_note: CMVR r.3 primary text not fetched; the two-wheeler wording (who may ride with a learner) must be checked when pinning.

rules.text_en: Documents to carry/produce (DL, RC, insurance, PUC)
rules.text_hi: साथ रखने/दिखाने के दस्तावेज़ (DL, RC, बीमा, PUC)
rules.source_title: Motor Vehicles Act 1988 / Central Motor Vehicles Rules 1989 (to pin)
rules.source_note: Section and rule numbers not pinned; DigiLocker / mParivahan acceptance per state is unverified (CURRICULUM LL4).

rules.text_en: Duties after a crash (help, report)
rules.text_hi: हादसे के बाद के कर्तव्य (मदद करना, सूचना देना)
rules.source_note: s.134 not re-fetched.
